source_row.rationale: Oppositional defiant disorder is characterized by a persistent pattern of angry/irritable mood, argumentative/defiant behavior toward authority figures, and vindictiveness, lasting at least 6 months. It is distinguished from conduct disorder by the absence of the more severe violations of others' basic rights (such as aggression toward people/animals or serious rule violations) seen in conduct disorder.
source_row.source_detail: Persistent angry/irritable mood, argumentative/defiant behavior, or vindictiveness for at least 6 months; updated 2024, accessed 2026-08-14.
